rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing public or personal support or approval.

example.traditional: 我哋公開支持呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 hoi1 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this for an official or public endorsement, or as the banking term for endorsing a cheque.

example.english: We formally endorse this new policy.
example.traditional: 我哋正式為呢項新政策背書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zing3 sik1 wai6 ni1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3 bui6 syu1

rows.jyutping: hai2 zi1 piu3 bui3 min6 cim1 meng2
rows.note: Use this plain construction when describing the physical act of signing the back of a cheque.

example.english: I need to endorse the cheque by signing the back before cashing it.
example.traditional: 我攞張支票去銀行兌現之前，要喺支票背面簽名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lo2 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 deoi3 jin6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 hai2 zi1 piu3 bui3 min6 cim1 meng2
